project_evidence.text: Education is the mean of total literacy, female literacy, and 100 minus the male-female literacy gap, from Census 2023.

Health counts hospitals, dispensaries, RHCs and BHUs in PHS Table 3 as at 31 December 2023, divides by Census 2023 population per 100,000, and min-max normalizes across all 36 census districts. It measures reported capacity, not quality or outcomes.

Accountability averages total and development DHA expenditure divided by final grant for FY 2023-24. Each contribution is bounded to 0–100; raw utilization and source discrepancies remain visible. Utilization is not proof of integrity or impact.

Overall is the equal-weight mean of the rounded education, health and accountability scores under punjab-v1. It combines Census 2023, health capacity at 31 December 2023 and FY 2023-24 DHA budgets, not an annual outcome or a politician rating.

GPIS punjab-v1 scores all 36 Census 2023 districts using Census 2023 literacy, PHS capacity as at 31 December 2023, and FY 2023-24 DHA budgets. It retains source citations, original pilot scores and explicit limitations.
